summary_1line: Bhrigu explains how bodily heat and the five vital breaths (prana and others) govern movement, digestion, circulation, and life within the body’s channels.

image_candidates.scene_text: A yogic diagram-like vision of a human body with streams of breath flowing through branching channels from the heart while a glowing fire burns at the navel.
A sage teaches a disciple while gesturing to the head and navel, describing the inner fire and the upward and downward movement of the breath.
Inside a translucent human body, a flame at the navel spreads warmth through luminous channels as currents of wind move through the joints and organs.
